readThisFirst: Any AI agent or new contributor working on this repository should start by running `bash .agents/checkpoint.sh resume`. That reads the latest session checkpoint AND this durable context. If there is no checkpoint, read this file first — it is the machine-readable index of everything else. Human-readable equivalents live in CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and docs/.

project.name: Sahaay Setu
project.oneLiner: Multilingual mobile app that matches marginalised entrepreneurs and students to the right concessional credit scheme and the nearest Channel Partner who can actually process it.
project.problemStatementTitle: AI-Driven Scheme Matching for Marginalized Entrepreneurs
project.organization: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
project.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
project.detail: See context/problem-statement.json for the full statement and the parsed requirement list.

ownership.note: This repository is the FRONTEND. It is built so a backend teammate can work in parallel without either side blocking the other.

responsibilities: React Native (Expo) mobile app, all screens and navigation
On-device rule engine (offline scheme recommendation fallback)
EMI / financial calculator (pure, offline, no backend)
Mock API server so the app is fully demoable with zero backend
The API contract (Zod schemas in src/api/contracts) — shared, changed jointly
Multilingual AI + RAG pipeline behind POST /v1/assistant/query
Real scheme catalogue (verified against official NSFDC circulars)
Real Channel Partner directory + live fund-health / NPA data
backendPartner.integrationSwitch: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_USE_MOCK_API=false in .env. Nothing else in the app changes.

stack.validation: zod — the API contract is Zod schemas, validated at the network boundary
stack.maps: react-native-maps (lazily and defensively loaded; list view is the primary UX)
stack.speech: expo-speech for text-to-speech out; speech-to-text is NOT implemented in v0

structure.app/: expo-router routes. File path = URL path. Screens only — no business logic here.
structure.app/(tabs)/: The five bottom tabs: home, schemes, calculator, partners, profile.
structure.app/onboarding/: Language selection (first screen anyone sees) and the intro carousel.
structure.app/recommend/: Smart Scheme Recommender wizard (index) and its results screen.
structure.src/api/contracts/: ⚠️ SHARED CONTRACT. Zod schemas that both frontend and backend must satisfy. Changing these is a cross-team change.
structure.src/api/services/: The ONLY way screens reach data. Each service picks mock vs real backend.
structure.src/api/mock/: In-memory mock backend + seed fixtures. Never imported by a screen directly.
structure.src/features/calculator/emi.ts: Pure EMI math. No React, no network. Verified against textbook values.
structure.src/features/recommender/ruleEngine.ts: Deterministic on-device scheme matching. Offline fallback + explainability baseline.
structure.src/components/ui/: Generic design-system primitives. No domain knowledge.
structure.src/hooks/: React Query hooks and device-capability hooks.
structure.src/i18n/: i18n setup and locale JSON. en.json is the source of truth.
structure.src/store/: zustand persisted store (language, profile, saved schemes).
structure.src/theme/: Design tokens. Never hardcode a colour or spacing value in a component.
structure.src/utils/: Pure helpers (Indian number formatting, geo distance).
structure.context/: Machine-readable project context for AI agents (this directory).
structure..agents/: Cross-AI working protocol (PROTOCOL.md), the checkpoint CLI (checkpoint.sh) and project skills (skills/).
structure..checkpoints/: Session-by-session agent state. Committed to git — this is project history, not scratch. _latest.json points at the most recent.

conventions.imports: Always use the '@/' alias for src (e.g. '@/components/ui'). Metro resolves it from tsconfig paths — there is deliberately no babel.config.js.
conventions.dataFlow: screen → hook (src/hooks) → service (src/api/services) → mock OR real HTTP. A screen must never import from src/api/mock or call fetch.
conventions.styling: StyleSheet.create at the bottom of the file, values from '@/theme' only.
conventions.text: Use the Text component from '@/components/ui', never react-native's Text — it carries the Indic-script line heights.
conventions.strings: No user-visible string may be hardcoded. Add it to src/i18n/locales/en.json and use t('key').
conventions.money: Whole rupees as integers. Format via '@/utils/format' so grouping is lakh/crore, not thousands.
conventions.touchTargets: Minimum 48dp. Body text minimum 16px. Status is never conveyed by colour alone.
conventions.unverifiedData: Any scheme figure not confirmed against an official circular must carry verified:false, which makes the UI show a warning chip. Never silently present seed data as authoritative.

dataHonesty.warning: Mixed, and the distinction is the point. SCHEMES: five of eight are verified against nsfdc.nic.in/scheme (2026-09-07) and carry verified:true with citations; three carry verified:false and are shown with a warning. PARTNERS: the five agency names and their SCA role are verified; no phone numbers and no NPA or fund-utilisation figures are carried at all, because NSFDC does not publish per-partner figures — every partner is status UNKNOWN. ASSISTANT: keyword matching, not a model. Nothing here is invented; what is not known is marked as not known.
dataHonesty.beforePublicDemo: Verify the three remaining schemes (MSY, LVY, GBS) and flip verified:true only as each is confirmed from nsfdc.nic.in. Obtain the partner master and a fund-health feed before any partner shows a status other than UNKNOWN. Get mr/bn/ta/te reviewed by native speakers. Do not remove a warning to make the demo look cleaner — ADR-009.
dataHonesty.assistantIsNotAI: src/api/mock/fixtures/assistant.ts is keyword matching, not a model. It exists so the chat UI can be built before the RAG pipeline lands.

privacy.principle: Collect the minimum needed to recommend a scheme.
privacy.storage: Everything stays on-device in AsyncStorage. The profile is sent to the backend only as a request body, never persisted server-side in v0.
privacy.location: Requested only when the user taps 'Use my location', never on app start.

smartSchemeRecommender.backendNeeded: POST /v1/recommendations for AI/RAG-grounded reasoning and citations

geoSpatialPartnerLocator.status: implemented; agency names verified, per-partner fund data does not exist publicly
geoSpatialPartnerLocator.backendNeeded: POST /v1/partners/search with the real partner master and a fund-health feed. The norms are already encoded per partner type; requiredInputsFor(type) returns the exact fields NSFDC would have to supply. Until then every partner is UNKNOWN.
geoSpatialPartnerLocator.keyRule: onlyAccepting defaults to true — never route an applicant to a partner that cannot disburse

multilingual.status: 6 languages, all complete (319 keys); mr/bn/ta/te AI-translated pending native review
multilingual.frontend: src/i18n/, app/onboarding/language.tsx, app/assistant.tsx, app/voice.tsx, src/features/voice/ (speech-to-text providers, TTS, BCP-47 speech locales)
multilingual.backendNeeded: the AI must answer in the language passed as responseLanguage. Optionally POST /v1/assistant/transcribe, which would enable voice input on native.

knownGaps: Speech-to-text (voice input) is not implemented — needs a dev build or the backend transcribe endpoint.
mr/bn/ta/te locales are ~20% translated; missing keys fall back to English by design.
No automated test suite yet; EMI math and the rule engine were verified by script during development.
react-native-maps needs a development build for full functionality; the app degrades to a list view.
No authentication — v0 is deliberately anonymous.

agentMemory.principle: Chat history is not project state. A new session must be able to resume from files alone.

durable.holds: What the project IS — identity, ownership, domain rules, decisions, current milestone

session.holds: What happened this session — task, progress, verified facts, exactly what to do next
session.pointer: .checkpoints/_latest.json names the most recent checkpoint and which agent wrote it

agentMemory.cli: .agents/checkpoint.sh — resume | save | verify | list | show | diff | prune
agentMemory.cadence: Checkpoint every ~15 minutes and before anything destructive. Promote milestones into context/state.json.
agentMemory.proofRule: Every verified fact must carry the command that proves it. A claim without a proof forces the next agent to re-derive it.
agentMemory.reconciliation: A checkpoint records the git commit it was written against. `resume` and `diff` compare it to reality and report SAME COMMIT / uncommitted changes / DIVERGED. Never resume off a checkpoint that disagrees with git.
